name: write-backend-documentation
description: Research a backend codebase end-to-end, propose an approval-gated documentation plan, then generate developer- and LLM-agent-oriented documentation in a consistent house style. Auto-detects language, framework, API surface, data layer, background processing, auth, config, observability, build/deploy, and tests with path:line evidence. The entry point is a root-level README.md linking into a documentation/ tree. Existing docs are archived, never blindly overwritten.
